import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0014 (m n : Nat) (h : m ≥ n) : m^n ≤ (m+1)^n := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0014 (m n : Nat) (h : m ≥ n) : m^n ≤ (m+1)^n := by
  induction n with i hi
  · have : m^0 ≤ (m+1)^0 := by simp [pow_zero]
    exact this
  · have : (m+1)^i ≤ (m+2)^i := by
      have : m^i ≤ (m+1)^i := hi h
      rw [pow_add, pow_add, mul_le_mul_left (m+1)^i this]
      simp [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (m+1)^i (by norm_num : (m+1) + (m+1) ≥ 0)]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0014 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0014 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0014

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0014
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0014
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
